questions.prompt: What is Pro Portal mainly used for?

questions.explanation: All four are kinds of support at college.

questions.prompt: According to the deck, asking for help early is…
options: Only for students who are struggling
One of the smartest things you can do at college
Something teachers prefer you didn't do

questions.prompt: How does the deck describe the induction sessions coming up over the next three weeks?
options: They are mocks of your final exams
They are short, supportive sessions, not tests
questions.explanation: None of them are tests. They're here to help you settle and succeed.
